episodes.title: Learning distributed distributional representations of uncertainty

screening.publisher_promise: Sahani presents distributed distributional codes, in which neural populations represent beliefs through expectations of nonlinear features, and shows how such codes can be learned.
screening.screening_reason: The co-originator of DDCs derives a representation of uncertainty that supports learning and inference without explicit sampling, a principled alternative to the sampling account. Rubric: A✓ B✓ C✓ · D 2 · E 2 · F 2.
screening.transcript_question: How are DDCs learned (for example via the wake-sleep idea), and what predictions separate them from sampling-based and parametric codes?
